content:
**Hide and Seek and Destroy** is a repeatable quest in *Fallout 76*.

| Main Quest: Hide and Seek and Destroy | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 
| Use the surveillance system terminal in the command center of the Whitespring bunker. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 
| Initiate the search for a nuclear keycard. | | | | | | | | Initiate the search for a silo code piece. | | | | | | 
| Search the highlighted area for a cargobot. | | | | | | | | Search the highlighted area for a Scorched or feral ghoul officer. | | | | | | 
| Shoot down the cargobot and retrieve the nuclear keycard. | | | | | | | | Defeat the officer and retrieve the silo code piece. | | | | | | 
| Reward: 250 XP | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 

Start this quest by going to the Whitespring bunker and use the surveillance system terminal to initiate a search for a cargobot or a silo code piece. If a cargobot is sought out, the general location of the cargobot will be marked on the map. The cargobot must be destroyed and a nuclear keycard must be retrieved from the secure supply container it dropped, though picking the lock triggers the container's auto self-destruct. If a silo code piece is sought out, it will highlight an area with a Scorched or feral ghoul officer that will be in the vicinity with the code piece. The officer must be killed and the silo code piece retrieved from its body. Once the associated item has been added to the player character's inventory, the quest will complete.

Using the "Steal from" option when interacting with the crate dropped by a cargobot counts towards the "Pick a Lock" challenge.
